name: SDK Guide
author: ResonantOS
description: An interactive 13-step tutorial that teaches the @resonantos/addon-sdk by using it on this same loopback origin. Steps 1-9 walk every REF (ADR-055) host-policy boundary: discovery, manifest validation (a live validateAddOnManifest run against this very addon.json), capability request, host consent, grant, sandboxed UI render, an authorized call (real 200), a denied call (real 401 — wrong bearer), and a revoked call (real 403 — host withdrew the grant). Steps 10-13 run the current SDK surface for real: runtime lifecycle projection (deriveDesiredRuntimeState + projectLifecycleSnapshot), the harness-resource contract failing closed against this add-on's grants, a live in-memory terminal-host session, and the ADR-056 §7 F1-F10 failure-mode table. No step is hard-coded: every denial is a real host-policy result.

surfaces.label: SDK Guide
surfaces.description: Walk the full REF lifecycle on a single add-on, then keep going into the current SDK: lifecycle projection, harness resources, terminal lane, and the F1-F10 hardening contract. The UI calls its own loopback upstream at each step; the upstream enforces every host-policy boundary symmetrically with Echo and Counter. Host revocation flips a real flag; the same bearer that succeeded moments earlier then returns 403 — and step 10's projection flips to stopped/addon-revoked.

grantPresets.label: Local SDK guide
grantPresets.description: Grant the local SDK guide upstream the host-minted bearer so the 9 steps can complete.
